R1 Scientific Method.basis: Source-only evaluation, CFD-validation thresholding, no target metrics, no premature winner selection.

R2 Software Architecture.basis: J2E uses the validated shared pipeline; no model/trainer/evaluator core change in the training evidence.

R3 Numerical Stability.basis: All completed checkpoints and evaluated metric payloads are finite; EMA and completion artifacts are present.

R4 Reproducibility.basis: Frozen original branch, addendum branch, hashes, dataset manifests, environment, and checkpoint identities are recorded.

R5 Experimental Design.basis: Same seed, scheduler horizon, canonical batch partition, CFD validation policy, and exact factorial contrasts are recorded.

R6 GPU Runtime.basis: RTX 3090 preflight passed; J2E endpoint reached with GIC inactive; J4 reached both required branches.

R7 Target Leakage.basis: All source-evaluation artifacts state target_data_accessed=false and target_metrics_seen=false; target remains closed.

R8 Journal Review.basis: Trajectory and interaction evidence are reported without claiming OOD generalization or selecting a final model.
